profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
At Nebulon Group, my focus has been on spearheading the development of a high-frequency trading platform, applying my expertise in data architecture, machine learning, and event-driven systems. My role involves leading and collaborating with a global team to build a real-time trading engine and to build, deploy, and serve ML models, ensuring seamless integration with a tiered data lake infrastructure.

At Guild Education, I worked as a Software Architect focusing on performance, scalability, event-driven architecture, and domain-driven design to enhance organizational efficiency and developer productivity. I worked as a technical leader closely with directors, staff engineers, 5 product teams, and collaborated across the product and tech organization of over 200 engineers.

As a principal software engineer and architect at NFTools and Aterian, I was in charge of technical direction implementing scalable, distributed, and event-driven data processing systems leveraging Apache Kafka and Apache Spark. I designed, implemented, mentored, and led teams of over 25 engineers on domain-driven design, distributed systems, security, computer science best practices, design patterns, AI, Web3 (blockchain), observability, and testing. At Aterian, I was the only principal software engineer and architect, launching the startup from an idea to over 180mm in revenue.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led architecture and engineering on a global team of mathematicians and data scientists to build a high-frequency trading platform for Australian-based sports.
• Designed and built an ML model training, deployment, and real-time model inference platform on Databricks.
• Architected and engineered a tiered data lake architecture with batch and streamed updates and model feature store generation with Databricks, Spark, serverless, and event-driven architectures.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Scikit-Learn · R (Programming Language) · Apache Spark · Databricks · C# · Microservices · Microsoft Azure · Datadog

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
- Designed organization-wide event-driven architecture (EDA) standards, patterns, and practices. Built platform library. Worked with teams on complex event processing patterns built on top of AWS Kinesis.
- Facilitated event storming and domain driven design (DDD) sessions across the organization to identify hotspots, friction and restructure domain boundaries.
- Optimized end to end workloads for performance, observability, maintainability, and to increase developer velocity.
- Mentored staff and senior engineers across the organization via code reviews, system designs, performance, DDD, and EDA.
- Systems implemented with Python, Typescript, CDK, GitHub for CI/CD, Snowflake, Looker, DataDog,  and AWS cloud services including: Lambda, AppSync, Kinesis, EventBridge, AWS Glue, Aurora, and others.
positions.insights: Skills: Delegation · Apache Spark · Datadog · Python · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Security · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Event Driven Architecture · GraphQL · Communication

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and engineered an automated trading system for non-fungible tokens on the Ethereum blockchain
* Architected and built a data lake and big data processing platform using Azure, Databricks, and Spark structured streaming that predicted trends and prices for different trade assets. Built with C# and Python.
* Architected and created real-time event processing systems that sent notifications to microservices based on Ethereum blockchain transaction logs and interacted with smart contracts to buy and sell assets. Built in C# and NodeJs.
* Managed, trained, and mentored a remote team of 5 on Web3 technologies, DDD, TDD, and other methodologies
* System leveraged Terraform for infrastructure as code, Github actions for CI/CD, and Docker for a local development experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Delegation · Blockchain · NoSQL · C# · Azure Databricks · Apache Spark · Python · TypeScript · Spark · Algorithms · Web3 · Security · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Event Driven Architecture · Apache Kafka · Databricks

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Designed and built systems that took the company from a startup idea to a publicly traded company posting over 180MM last year
* Architected and created event-based systems using Azure Event Hubs (Kafka) and Spark to predict market forces and forecast trends
* Designed stateful, long running, dynamic workflows engine using Akka.net, created PPC ad and repricing strategies
* Designed and developed CQRS microservices and cross team event processing and REST APIs and patterns
* Designed and built the financial dashboards, full stack from v1 in ASP.NET MVC to a more modern ReactJS SPA with REST backend including Storybook, Jest unit tests and Cypress E2E tests
* Created data ingestion pipelines with Spark and built analytics dashboards using REST, SQL, and Elasticsearch 
* Leveraged countless cloud-based services from hyper-scale SQL servers, telemetry, serverless functions, and cognitive services to create conversation bots, managed infrastructure as code with Terraform
positions.insights: Skills: Delegation · C# · Azure Databricks · Messaging · Microsoft SQL Server · Apache Spark · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Microsoft Azure · Python · TypeScript · Spark · Algorithms · Test Driven Development · Event Hub · REST APIs · Terraform · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Security · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Event Driven Architecture · GitHub · Apache Kafka · Microservices · Databricks · Communication · Kubernetes

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked with doctors, health professionals, funders, and data analysts to create a tool for managing neglected tropical disease data that was officially adopted by WHO and regional offices around the world
* Designed and developed a dynamic system for collecting, validating, and reporting on epidemiology indicators, budgets, medicine requests, and interventions from doctors and public health officials
* Developed the system to work in remote areas without internet and with outdated technology
* Managed product requirements, training team members, and continuous software delivery

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
* Architected and developed a highly scalable and reliable event based system for processing real-time sports betting prices and statistics utilizing NServiceBus and micro services with 99.9% uptime
* Built a web application leveraging Elasticsearch to create predictive systems and with push notifications on database filtering that supports over 10k active users and generates over $2MM in yearly revenue 
* Developed iOS and Android phone applications for real time notifications, sports event results, ratings, and integration with bookmaking APIs
* Built a web application with advanced search ux, profile management, data filtering, and content management that has become Australia’s largest horse racing form database with over 100m records
positions.insights: Skills: Delegation · Amazon CloudSearch · C# · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Nservicebus · Algorithms · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Event Driven Architecture · Redis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed a multithreaded application managing a data processing cluster analyzing terabytes of data
* Researched and developed data visualization and filtering solutions for huge datasets leveraging C# and search engine technology
* Created and led training sessions on Test Driven Development and Domain Driven Design
* Designed and developed a file copying service that managed multiple VMs and parallelized the transferring and processing of data resulting in increasing the efficiency of this process by 200%
* Built the framework of tracking tools that reported user productivity
positions.insights: Skills: Delegation · C# · Algorithms · Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Core responsibilities: refactoring legacy systems, leading object-oriented systems design, payments processing, shipping and inventory management systems integrations, accounting, order processing, service-oriented architecture, and affiliate marketing.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft SQL Server · Security · PHP
